strategic_differentiation: The project's differentiation within the MSCA-PF evaluation frame operates on two levels. At the research level (Excellence 50%), the proposal targets the single empty cell in the systematic literature review's research-gap matrix — Real-Time Decision Support × PlanetScope — and claims the underdeveloped end-to-end combination of learned multimodal fusion, explicit probabilistic crop-water-state estimation, and economically optimised irrigation decision support as its novel contribution (strategic_positioning.md section 1.1, grounded in the gap matrix from concept_note.md). The methodological distinction is the 'honest uncertainty chain' carried without collapse from multi-sensor observation through probabilistic diagnosis to profit-based irrigation recommendation, combined with a risk-managed two-route architecture: a rigorous probabilistic-fusion route (Route A) and a lighter homogeneous-patch proxy route (Route B) that sidesteps the sub-pixel resolution problem, both sharing one downstream decision engine (strategic_positioning.md section 1.2; concept_note.md scientific and technical approach). The novelty claim is deliberately narrow — defensible only if the uncertainty chain is kept honest — and is anchored in a systematic literature review covering 50 papers (concept_note.md state of the art). At the MSCA structural level (researcher/host merit — Implementation 20%, Impact 30% career dimensions), the concept explicitly acknowledges that researcher, supervisor, and host positioning (sub-sections 1.3, 1.4, 2.1, 3.2) are spine-dependent and blocked pending confirmation of the fellow, supervisor, and host; these dimensions are deferred to confirmation_checklist.json resolution rather than fabricated.
